quoted_tweet.text:
Most trading bots follow rules.

Ours doesn’t.

What we built is closer to a coordinated AI system than a bot — a stack of models that actually interpret the market in real time and make decisions together.

At the core of the system are multiple AI agents: Claude, OpenClaw, Cod3x, and several internal models we’ve trained specifically for high-frequency perp environments. Each one is focused on a different layer of the market.

One continuously reads the tape, tracking aggressive buyers and sellers and identifying when real momentum is building. Another monitors order book depth, looking for liquidity shifts, spoofing behavior, and hidden pressure. A separate model analyzes funding rates, volatility expansion, and cross-venue signals to understand the broader context. And then there’s the execution layer — a model dedicated entirely to timing, entries, and minimizing slippage.

But none of these models act alone.

Before any trade is placed on Hyperliquid, the system runs a multi-model consensus. Signals are compared, weighted, and stress-tested internally. If alignment isn’t strong enough, the system simply does nothing.

No forced trades. No overtrading.

Another key part of the system is regime detection.

The AI constantly evaluates what kind of market it’s operating in — whether it’s trending, ranging, volatile, or being manipulated. And based on that, it completely shifts behavior. In strong trends, it leans into momentum. In choppy conditions, it reduces exposure or stays out entirely. In high-risk environments, it prioritizes capital preservation over profit.

This is where most systems fail — they trade the same way in every condition. Ours doesn’t.

In Pro Mode, the system becomes significantly more aggressive and precise.

It dynamically adjusts position sizing, leverage, entry timing, and scaling strategies in real time. Not based on fixed rules, but based on continuously recalculated risk. The same setup can result in completely different trade execution depending on current liquidity, volatility, and confidence across models.

Execution itself is another layer most people underestimate.

We built latency-aware routing specifically for Hyperliquid. The system understands when to execute instantly, when to sit passively in the order book, and when to split orders to reduce slippage and improve fills. This isn’t just signal-based trading — it’s execution-aware trading.

And then there’s the feedback loop.

Every trade feeds back into the system. Wins and losses are both used to refine how models interpret order flow, volatility, and liquidity behavior. Over time, the system doesn’t just repeat strategies — it adapts and evolves.

That’s the real difference.

This isn’t a static bot running predefined logic. It’s a live system of interacting AI agents operating inside one of the most liquid perp environments in crypto.

Most bots react to the market.

This system tries to understand it first — and act only when it has an edge.

And that’s exactly why Pro Mode stands out the most.

Quick breakdown of the MM section.

There are 3 sets: Aggressive / Fast / Manual settings. + PRO mode.

Aside from choosing your balance, leverage, and max loss, the key difference between them, and what you can fully control in Manual, comes down to these parameters:

1. Take Profit (bps): how far the price needs to move in your favor before the bot locks in profit
2. Stop Loss (bps): how far the price moves against your position before the bot cuts the loss
3. Max Hold (sec): if neither TP nor SL is triggered, the bot will still close the position after this time and open a new one

💀PRO Mode: everything is fully optimized. The bot automatically selects the best leverage, TP/SL, max hold, and more. We’ve spent 200+ hours refining this.

Trade smart, experiment with different settings, and find what works best for you.
